_comment: Level-up cost tables for Pokemon Sleep helpers, game Ver.3.6.0 (level cap 70).
Public game data only; no user data. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
[N] nitoyon/pokesleep-tool src/util/Exp.ts and src/data/pokemon.json (GitHub, Exp.ts last data change 2026-06-25 'Update EXP 66-70' after the Ver.3.6.0 switch).

[P] Pokebip 'Pokemon Sleep - niveau et experience' (pokebip.com/page/jeux-video/pokemon-sleep/niveau-experience): cumulative EXP per EXP type for Lv2/10/25/30/50/60/61/65/66/70, shards per candy, EXP groups.
[G] Game8 JP level table (game8.jp/pokemonsleep/603715, updated 2025-11-21): EXP 54/1066/1362/2806 for Lv2/50/51/60 and shards per candy up to Lv60.
[S] Serebii 'Pokemon Level Up' (serebii.net/pokemonsleep/levelup.shtml): shards per candy by current level, Lv1-50.
[W] wikiwiki.jp/poke_sleep 'アメ': candy EXP 40 (to Lv25) / 35 (Lv25-30) / 25 (Lv30+); 35/30/25 up to Ver.3.5.2; flat 25 up to Ver.2.9.0.
[E] vendored Neroli's Lab common/src/types/nature/nature.ts: EXP-up natures (exp 1.18) and EXP-down natures (exp 0.82).
[H] SH11235/pokemonsleep-management src/constants/index.ts (2025): cumulative EXP and shards up to Lv65, EXP-type ratios; has a typo at Lv61 (59280 instead of 57280).
Cross-checks: cumulative EXP agrees across [N],[P],[H] for Lv1-65 and [N],[P] for Lv66-70; per-level EXP and shards agree with [G] at Lv2/50/51/60.
shards_per_candy agrees across [N],[S],[G],[P],[H]; Lv66-69 only in [N],[P].
Rounding: [N] rounds the scaled cumulative EXP half up; [P] matches that everywhere except the 1080 type at Lv60/61 (+1) and Lv70 (-1).
Uncertain: Lv66-70 values come from community measurement ([N] changed them once after Ver.3.6.0); MEWTWO EXP type (1080) is from [N] only;
nature candy EXP for Ver.3.6.0 brackets (47/33, 41/29) is from [N] only and matches round-half-up of base x 1.18 / x 0.82 ([E]).
cumulative_exp_note: cumulative_exp[i] is the total EXP from Lv1 to reach Lv(i+1) for the 600 (normal) EXP type, i.e. index 0 is Lv1. Sources [N],[P],[H],[G].
shards_per_candy_note: shards_per_candy[i] is the dream shards per candy while the helper is at Lv(i+1) (raising it toward Lv(i+2)), i.e. index 0 is Lv1. Sources [N],[S],[G],[P],[H].
candy_exp_note: EXP per candy by the helper's current level. below_level is exclusive: a Lv24 helper gets the first bracket, Lv25 the second. Base values [W],[N]; up/down values [N].
exp_types_note: Required EXP per level is the normal table times the multiplier, rounded half up on cumulative values ([N]; matches [P] for every listed row). Species not listed use 600.
mini_candy_boost_note: Mini candy boost (ミニアメブースト): candy EXP x2, shard cost x4, at most 50 candies per day ([N],[H], Game8 EN/pokemongo-raku news). The daily cap is not modelled.
